about: Committed coverage baseline read by eval-coverage-contract.test.js. Every list is a ratchet: a new gap fails
the contract until it is closed or recorded here, and an entry that is closed (now captured, now checked, now
graded) or no longer exists fails it until the entry is removed.
uncaptured: registered genpage prompts with no stored fixture, so neither runner grades them.
unscored: per-eval genpage expectations with no registered check in either runner, so they report SKIP.
status is "deferred" when an offline check could grade the stored artifacts, "manual" when a person has to
neverGraded: registered checks that return SKIP on every fixture they run on, so they verify nothing yet.
eval null is a common assertion. reason is the SKIP reason the check gives.
